newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine says hryvnia intervention only tactical.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine says hryvnia intervention only tactical.

text.p: The chief of Ukraine's central bank on Wednesday confirmed that the hryvnia currency, which has been slipping in recent weeks, will be left free to find its own level without heavy intervention from the bank.
"The National Bank of Ukraine will use tactical intervention on the money market, regardless of whatever trend the hryvnia rate is demonstrating," Viktor Yushchenko told reporters.
He said the bank would not interfere in recent growth in demand for hard currency. The hryvnia fell to 1.81 to the dollar on the Ukraine Interbank Currency Exchange on Wednesday from 1.80 on Tuesday.
The hryvnia stood at 1.76 to the dollar, the rate set at its September 2 debut, until October 7, when the central bank said it stopped intervening to maintain the level.
